newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - Bund vol gains ahead of U.S. PPI data.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Bund vol gains ahead of U.S. PPI data.

text.p: Implied volatility of Bund and other options on LIFFE rose in brisk trade for a Friday session ahead of U.S. data, brokers said.
"Pretty much everything is up on yesterday," said one broker from a British firm.
The broker quoted August mid-price Bund volatility at 4.32 percent, against a 4.23 percent LIFFE close on Thursday.
September was up to 4.67 percent from 4.63 percent, and October rose to 5.05 percent from 4.92 percent.
U.S. June producer price data will be released at 1230 GMT, and are expected to be unchanged from May, compared with a previous 0.3 percent decline.

The German cabinet approved its 1998 draft budget and 1997 supplementary budget on Friday. The supplementary budget raises the projected deficit to 71.2 billion marks from an original plan of 53.3 billion, but the government has said it still expects to qualify for European economic and monetary union.
September Bund futures were at 102.86 at 1115 GMT, up 15 basis points.
"Volatility will erode before the end of the day," said one broker from a U.S. firm.
A number of trades were executed at the 103.00 and 103.50 strikes, brokers said.
One firm sold 2,100 103.00 calls and bought 1,900 103.50 calls, Other firms were outright buyers or sellers of calls at those strikes, brokers added.
